description: This file contains client-side JavaScript code responsible for managing file uploads within a web application. It handles actions such as initiating uploads, updating progress bars, polling upload status, displaying messages, and interacting with iframes for file transfer operations.

methods.name: uploadPartyContent
methods.description: Initializes and configures the iframe for uploading party content, resets progress bar, and prepares the UI for upload.

methods.name: uploadCompleted
methods.description: Handles the completion of the upload process by updating the content list, displaying a message, and cleaning up temporary elements.

methods.name: checkIframeStatus
methods.description: Polls periodically to check if the upload iframe has completed updating, then proceeds to finalize the upload process.

methods.name: getUploadProgressStatus
methods.description: Begins polling the server for upload progress updates, updates progress bar and messages, and stops polling when complete or on error.
